vocabulary.meaning: 给… 留下印象；使敬佩

examples.text: If you’re having a hard time being happy for a friend who just got an awesome promotion, it’s probably because you made the situation about you somehow.
examples.translation: 如果朋友刚获得很好的晋升，你却很难为对方高兴，那很可能是因为你不知不觉把这件事往自己身上联想了。
examples.speechText: If you’re having a hard time being happy for a friend who just got an awesome promotion, it’s probably because you made the situation about you somehow.

examples.text: It has been reported that more than one kid has been infected（infect的过去分词形式） with “Bird Flu”.
examples.translation: 据报道，不止一个孩子感染了“禽流感”。
examples.speechText: It has been reported that more than one kid has been infected with “Bird Flu”.

examples.text: Not until recently did they encourage the development of tourist-related activities in the rural areas.
examples.translation: 直到最近，他们才开始鼓励农村地区发展与旅游相关的活动。
examples.speechText: Not until recently did they encourage the development of tourist-related activities in the rural areas.

examples.text: When you ask the question, you expect the answer, she says.
examples.translation: 她说，你提出问题时，就是期待得到回答。
examples.speechText: When you ask the question, you expect the answer, she says.

examples.text: She found that backward walking increases leg flexibility and improves balance and stability.
examples.translation: 她发现，倒着走能提高腿部灵活性，改善平衡性和稳定性。
examples.speechText: She found that backward walking increases leg flexibility and improves balance and stability.

examples.text: So far as we know, there are 107 elements（element的复数形式） found in nature.
examples.translation: 据我们所知，自然界中发现的元素有107种。
examples.speechText: So far as we know, there are 107 elements found in nature.

examples.text: More than one hundred newspapers and magazines（magazine的复数形式） in the language were published regularly throughout the world.
examples.translation: 一百多种用该语言出版的报刊杂志在全世界定期发行。
examples.speechText: More than one hundred newspapers and magazines in the language were published regularly throughout the world.

examples.text: Emily Dickinson was a nineteenth-century American woman who lived her life completely unknown to anyone except her family and a few friends.
examples.translation: 艾米莉·狄金森是十九世纪的一位美国女性；她一生默默无闻，除了家人和几个朋友，其他人都不知道她。
examples.speechText: Emily Dickinson was a nineteenth-century American woman who lived her life completely unknown to anyone except her family and a few friends.

examples.text: To make a good impression, you should wear professional clothes and look neat and clean.
examples.translation: 为了给人留下好印象，你应该穿职业装，看起来整洁干净。
examples.speechText: To make a good impression, you should wear professional clothes and look neat and clean.

examples.text: The major role of these mobile apps is to help people buy favorite goods.
examples.translation: 这些手机软件的主要作用是帮助人们购买心仪的商品。
examples.speechText: The major role of these mobile apps is to help people buy favorite goods.

examples.text: For example, lots of ads pop up when you click on a link.
examples.translation: 例如，当你点击一个链接时，会弹出许多广告。
examples.speechText: For example, lots of ads pop up when you click on a link.

examples.text: Some activities, like discussing and reading, are basic to studying（study的-ing形式）.
examples.translation: 讨论、阅读等活动是学习的基础。
examples.speechText: Some activities, like discussing and reading, are basic to studying.

examples.text: Others are very violent in their expression of anger.
examples.translation: 另一些人表达愤怒的方式十分激烈。
examples.source: （2021年真题·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: Others are very violent in their expression of anger.

examples.text: Fitz Patrick has two children at the school.
examples.translation: Fitz Patrick有两个孩子在这所学校上学。
examples.speechText: Fitz Patrick has two children at the school.

examples.text: But many sites inappropriate to young people are clever at using words with double meanings that may appear harmless.
examples.translation: 但许多不适合年轻人的网站，善于使用一些表面无害、实际上有双重含义的词。
examples.speechText: But many sites inappropriate to young people are clever at using words with double meanings that may appear harmless.
